Day trip ideas

What to do around Vranov in every season.

Spring

Spring March – May

  • Cycle routes round the reservoir and into Podyjí, before the summer crowds
  • Hillsides in bloom in Podyjí National Park
  • Vranov nad Dyjí chateau and Bítov castle open for the season
  • Wine cellars around Znojmo
Summer

Summer June – August

  • Chmelnice beach 100 m away, swimming and free rowing boats
  • Boat trips on the reservoir
  • Bítov castle, Cornštejn ruins and Vranov chateau
  • Evening parties on the Panel terrace
Autumn

Autumn September – November

  • Znojmo historic wine harvest festival in September
  • Šobes vineyard and viewpoints above the Dyje
  • Mushroom picking in the woods around the reservoir
  • Evenings: sauna in the cellar and hot tub on the curtained terrace
Winter

Winter December – February

  • Walk to the Cornštejn ruins and along the frozen reservoir
  • Znojmo underground tunnels, open all year
  • Advent markets in Znojmo
  • A full day of wellness and the evening by the fire in the common room
